title: Certified firms that share an address, telephone, email domain or contact person
question: Which certified local firms share a street address, telephone, company email domain or contact person with another certified firm, and did the City record them as affiliates?
finding: 28 sets of two or more directory firms share an identifier (62 firms). 20 sets include a pair the directory does not record as affiliates, and in 5 of those all members appear on at least one contract team together (largest: AZUL WORKS INC; KM 106 Construction Inc., same street address, together on 4 contract(s)).
how: Business address (number, street and suite, with the ZIP code), the ten-digit telephone, the email domain (free-mail domains such as gmail are ignored) and the contact's full name are compared across the directory. A value held by more than six firms is ignored. Firms joined by any of these are one set. "Declared" means the directory lists the other firm among the participation-credit restrictions of one of the two. "Together" counts contracts whose team in the Controller's file includes every firm in the set.
limits: Small firms share buildings, bookkeepers and family members; two certified firms sharing an office can both be genuine. Contact names, telephones and addresses are used to link firms only and are not printed. A shared identifier is a lead for the certification file review, not a finding. The directory gives no owner names, so common ownership cannot be confirmed from it.
